LanguageData.FAF_AutoLoadDesc: Haulers load eligible items from lower-priority storage into this freezer. Change the Storage filter to choose items. Sleeping pads are fitted manually.
LanguageData.FAF_LoadItemDesc: Choose an item on the map. An available colonist carries it into this freezer. The storage filter still applies.
LanguageData.FAF_InstallMattressDesc: Choose a laid-out or packed sleeping pad from this map. If the main refrigerated compartment contains cargo, confirm moving it out first; the independent transport bay is unchanged. A colonist uninstalls the original pad if needed, then carries it into the freezer. Enable Allow sleeping to use the Nivarian bed.
LanguageData.FAF_CabinetMattressExclusive: Remove the sleeping pad before storing other items.
LanguageData.FAF_CabinetMustBeEmpty: Empty the freezer before fitting a sleeping pad.
LanguageData.FAF_EjectContentsDesc: Place the contents beside the freezer and forbid them to prevent immediate automatic reloading. Use the Contents tab to remove individual stacks.
LanguageData.FAF_NoCabinetHauler: No available colonist can carry this item to the freezer.
LanguageData.FAF_NoMattressesOnMap: No laid-out or packed Nivarian portable sleeping pad is available on this map.
LanguageData.FAF_NoMattressInstaller: No constructor/hauler available (check access and reservations).
LanguageData.FAF_NoMattressHauler: No hauler available (check access and reservations).
LanguageData.FAF_MattressNoLongerAvailable: The sleeping pad or freezer is no longer available for installation.
LanguageData.FAF_ItemNoLongerAvailable: The item or freezer storage space is no longer available.
LanguageData.FAF_CabinetOrderRejected: Could not reserve both the item and freezer. Check current reservations.
